page_title: PAL 2-1 CEL | Las Palmas v Celta Vigo 02/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: de la Torre L. Red Card

commentary.text: 90+9' Javier Alberola Rojas is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+8' Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+7' 2 - 1 Jonathan Viera provides Marc Cardona Rovira (Las Palmas) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a low shot into the middle of the goal.
90+6' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
90+4' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) makes a rough challenge and Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle for a foul.
90+4' A quickly taken corner by Las Palmas.
90+4' The free kick from long range, taken by Las Palmas, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+3' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

90+3' Las Palmas hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
90+1' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Javier Alberola Rojas no option but to blow his whistle.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
88' Rafael Benitez decides to make a substitution. Jorgen Strand Larsen will be replaced by Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo).
88' Substitution. Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) on for Fran Beltran.
87' Kirian (Las Palmas) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.

86' Marvin (Las Palmas) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Javier Alberola Rojas with no other option than to blow for a foul.
84' 1 - 1 Goal! Jonathan Viera (Las Palmas) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Ivan Villar into the bottom left corner.
84' Jonathan Viera (Las Palmas) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
83' Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.

83' Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle for an infringement. It's a penalty! Great chance to score for Las Palmas!
81' Javier Alberola Rojas has a clear sight and sees a foul from Marvin (Las Palmas).
80' The resulting set piece from Las Palmas is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
79' The referee signals a corner kick to Las Palmas.
77' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to substitute Pejino and he is replaced by Marc Cardona Rovira (Las Palmas).
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Enzo Loiodice departs the field of play to be replaced by Maximo Perrone (Las Palmas).
75' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Celta Vigo.
75' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) releases a promising shot from the free kick on the edge of the box. His effort towards the top right corner is comfortably saved by Alvaro Valles.
74' Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Javier Alberola Rojas had an easy-decision to make.

73' Joseph Aidoo (Celta Vigo) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
72' The referee awards a corner and Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) goes over to take it.
69' Substitution. Anastasios Douvikas walks off the pitch and Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) comes on as a substitute.
67' 0 - 1 Goal! A great through ball by Jonathan Bamba sets up Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball low into the middle of the goal. 0:1.
65' Javier Alberola Rojas blows for a foul after Carlos Dotor (Celta Vigo) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
63' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jonathan Viera (Las Palmas) replacing Javier Munoz.
63' A substitution has been made. Sory Kaba is replaced by Marvin (Las Palmas).
62' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Celta Vigo comes to nothing.
61' Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) commits a rough foul. Javier Alberola Rojas stops the game and makes a call.
60' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Javier Alberola Rojas has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
60' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) inside the box following a slide rule pass.

59' A great pass puts Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hits his shot against the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.
57' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
57' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle for a foul.
55' Kirian (Las Palmas) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
55' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) picks up a loose pass and unexpectedly unleashes a howitzer from distance, but the effort comes to nothing as a defender gets in the block.
54' A cross into the box from Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) is cleared.
53' Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Ivan Villar easily deals with the threat.
51' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player.
51' The attendance for today's match is 22472.
50' Ivan Villar makes a difficult save to deny Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas), who attempted to score with a header from inside the box.

48' Close! Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
48' The game is interrupted. Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
46' Referee Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+5' Joseph Aidoo (Celta Vigo) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Javier Alberola Rojas blows for a foul.
45+4' Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle. Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) commits a foul after dangerous play.
45+2' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Sory Kaba (Las Palmas) commits a rough challenge and Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle for a foul.
43' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo).
43' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
41' Las Palmas have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
39' Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) commits a rough challenge and Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle for an infringement.
38' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal due to a foul. The Celta Vigo players look gutted.
36' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an infringement in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Celta Vigo players aren’t happy.
34' GOAL! Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) finds the back of the net from close in from a very acute angle.
32' Julian Araujo is being substituted because of an injury. Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta sends Alvaro Lemos (Las Palmas) on the pitch.
29' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) is angry with himself. The ball breaks to him but he hits the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.
29' A fine pass finds Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Alvaro Valles reacts superbly to deny him.
29' Celta Vigo are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
27' The referee blows his whistle as Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) was too aggressive in his challenge.
26' Celta Vigo fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
26' Manu Sanchez (Celta Vigo) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
23' Unai Nunez (Celta Vigo) was too forceful with his tackle and Javier Alberola Rojas interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
23' Kirian (Las Palmas) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
22' Dangerous play by Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas). Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle for a foul.
21' Pejino (Las Palmas) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
19' Flag up against Sory Kaba (Las Palmas). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
17' It looks like Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) saw red with that tackle. Javier Alberola Rojas won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
16' The game is interrupted as Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) is flagged offside.

14' What a wasted opportunity by Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Ivan Villar makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
13' The ball possession at the moment is 81:19.
11' Rough tackle by Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
11' Javier Alberola Rojas couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) and blew his whistle.

10' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) gets the ball from a rebound and thumps a terrific long-range shot towards the net. Unfortunately for him, it sails narrowly high over the crossbar. Unlucky finish. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
9' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo).
5' Celta Vigo fail to score from a corner as Alvaro Valles (Las Palmas) leaps to collect the ball.

5' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
4' Kirian (Las Palmas) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
4' Some patient build-up play from Las Palmas as they look to unlock the defence.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Celta Vigo will kick the game off.
Javier Alberola Rojas is the one to supervise the game today.
